title: Puppet Master newbie-first Guided Tour contracts
description: Closed static contracts for the September 3 Chat/Teacher -> workspace -> Planning Wizard tour. Passing this schema proves only contract/fixture consistency, never browser, native Slint, runtime, accessibility, motion-quality, visual, or product acceptance.

purpose.const: Open real Assistant Chat, select Teacher, send the supplied local question, and apply ELI5 to the same answer.
Learn page and panel navigation, move or dock Chat, and perform a real widget action through its mounted owner.
Turn the book-club goal into three outcomes, edit a meaningful answer, and stop before approval with no work started.

continuity.const: The story moves from Assistant Chat and Teacher to workspace practice and finishes at the real Planning Wizard.

mobile_rule.const: Compact callouts keep the measured mounted target and every required choice usable inside the viewport.

text.const: A project groups one goal, its working files, configuration, recoverable versions, and approved work. Storage location and online source control are separate choices. Start with one clearly named project and verify its folder.
A project is one labeled box for an idea. Its pieces and save points stay together. Start with one box whose name you recognize.

normal.const: This practice Teacher can answer more than forty Puppet Master topics across navigation, panels, projects, Planning, history, online copies, storage, Servers, connections, security, runs, and accessibility. Ask one specific product question, such as “How do I rearrange panels?” or “How does local discovery work?” Broader questions can go to the regular Assistant after the tour.

eli5.const: This guidebook knows more than forty Puppet Master questions. Ask about moving around, projects, save points, connecting devices, safety, or getting unstuck. Try “How do I rearrange panels?”

prefixItems.const: What are the main parts of Puppet Master?
